stages.name: Capture brief
stages.description: Turn the raw idea into a structured brief (goals, pages, brand, audience).

stages.name: Design & UI/UX
stages.description: Derive fonts, color system and tokens from the brief; hero imagery via image-gen.

stages.name: Scaffold code + DB + architecture
stages.description: Generate a working Next.js app, DB schema and architecture notes into output/.

stages.name: Preview deploy
stages.description: Deploy the scaffolded site to a Vercel preview URL for review.

stages.name: Security audit
stages.description: Static scan of OWN code + header checks against OWN preview URL.

stages.name: Domain acquisition
stages.tool: Vercel domains API (real check; guarded purchase)
stages.description: MONEY GATE. Check availability/price; buy only with ALLOW_DOMAIN_PURCHASE=1.

stages.name: DNS & email records
stages.description: Build A/CNAME + SPF/DKIM/DMARC; write only with ALLOW_DNS_WRITE=1.

stages.name: Go live
stages.tool: Vercel REST API prod deploy (real; guarded)
stages.description: GO-LIVE GATE. Promote to production only with ALLOW_GO_LIVE=1.
